title: Chapter 1300
text:
What's she doing here? Why didn't she tell me in advance? "

Han Xiao was slightly stunned.

This woman was not a good person. She left the Black Star Corps decades ago and went to cause trouble with the Silver Revolutionary Army. Now that she suddenly came back, he did not know what she wanted.

"Army Commander, do you want to see her?"

"… Just for a while."

Han Xiao nodded. He was quite curious about Rossellin's intentions.

After the butterfly effect, the Silver Revolutionary Army basically did not have the chance to evolve into a big version event like in his previous life. He did not know what changes would happen to this group. Did Rossellin come to him this time to ask for help?

While guessing, Han Xiao got up and walked out of the office. He walked all the way to the reception room along the corridor. When he passed by the logistics department, he called Reynold, who was working hard, and brought him to see his sister, Rossellin.

Very soon, the two of them arrived outside the reception room. The door opened, and they saw Rossellin, whom they had not seen for a long time.

"Long time no see."

Han Xiao greeted casually and sized Rossellin up.

After not seeing her for so many years, Rossellin's appearance did not seem to have changed much. She was wearing an exquisite dark blue robe, and her temperament was calmer than decades ago.

"That's right, it's been so many years. You've now become a legendary figure in the universe. Even the three Universal Civilizations now view you as the most dangerous person. Thinking about your honeymoon period with the dynasty back then, it's really sad." Rossellin smiled.

"What's there to be sad about? Different positions have to consider different problems. The development of things always spirals. It's normal to have ups and downs," Han Xiao sat opposite Rossellin and replied casually.

"This isn't a spiral, is it? If you didn't create the Sanctum Revival, this era wouldn't have become what it is today. As expected of you, you easily completed what I couldn't do. Your ability to subvert the current situation is much stronger than mine. Do you feel any sense of accomplishment?" Rossellin blinked and said in a teasing tone.

"You're not worthy of giving me a sense of accomplishment." Han Xiao laughed.

Rossellin was not angry. She smiled and turned to look at Reynold as if she had just seen him. She pretended to be surprised. "Eh, stinky brother, you're still alive. I thought you'd died of overwork."

Leonard: "…"

Although you are my sister, if you continue to spout nonsense, do you believe that I will give you your favorite big mouth slap?

Han Xiao shook his head and smiled. "Let's not talk about me first. You, on the other hand, haven't done anything for decades. You only did me a small favor in Modo. How's your so-called career?"

"There's no improvement. The things you've done have indirectly hindered our business. What else can we do … But that's none of my business. I've already quit."

Rossellin shrugged and said in an indifferent tone, as if she did not care about the decades of futile effort.

The Intelligent Plague incident allowed the three Universal Civilizations to consolidate a wave of people's hearts, and the recent sanctions against the Beyond Grade A Association were approved by a large number of ordinary people who hated the strong. The Silver Revolutionary Army really could not move the ordinary people of the three Universal Civilizations, so their cause had come to a standstill.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.

This woman actually left the Silver Revolutionary Army … This was a little out of his expectations.

"So why did you come back to find me today?"

Rossellin spread her hands and smiled playfully.

"I can't stay idle. Since I lost my job, I have to find a new one. How about it, Army Commander, will you still take me in?"

"If I say no, what will you do?" Han Xiao raised his brows.

"Then I can only pester you …" Rossellin rolled her eyes and pretended to cry. "With our relationship, you can't bear to see me fall in love with someone else, right?"

"… Speak properly, don't talk about such incomprehensible things." Han Xiao coughed. "Now that the three Universal Civilizations are sanctioning us, you suddenly came back. I'm afraid you have other intentions."

Rossellin clapped her hands twice symbolically and smiled. "I really can't hide from your eyes. You also know that my goal is to deal with the three Universal Civilizations, but recently, I suddenly realized that to fight against the three Universal Civilizations, joining the association's faction seems to be more promising."

Han Xiao was speechless.

It seemed to be true. To a certain extent, the Beyond Grade A Association had achieved a part of the Silver Revolutionary Army in his previous life. Now that they had formed a faction to fight against the three Universal Civilizations, the commotion they caused was not much smaller than the Silver Revolutionary Army.

However, the Silver Revolutionary Army did not improve at all, causing Rossellin to feel that her future was bleak. Thus, she came back to join her old employer and changed her way of dealing with the three Universal Civilizations. Her goal did not change. With her personality, she was indeed capable of doing such a thing.

However, if this' key figure 'left, the Silver Revolutionary Army would only have a few big cats left, and there would be no chance for them to rise up.

This meant that although he did not deliberately target the Silver Revolutionary Army, the butterfly effect that he set off had indirectly killed the Silver Revolutionary Army. It was quite a bit of a disaster for the innocent.

So, was this considered Rossellin abandoning the dark and joining the light?

Han Xiao shook his head and said with a heavier tone, "Fine.

Since you're willing to return to the army despite the limelight, I can give you a way out and take you in. However, from now on, you can no longer have any contact with the Silver Revolutionary Army. If you leave the army again, even with Reynold around, I won't give you face and let you come back. Do you understand? "

He did not mind recruiting Rossellin again. Although this woman's thoughts were dangerous, her abilities were indeed rare and strategic. She was a trump card that could topple a ruler. It was best to keep such a talent in his hands.

"Alright, I won't leave you this time." Rossellin blinked and said with a flirtatious tone.

Reynold frowned upon hearing this.

Something is wrong with this woman. Is she trying to seduce Black Star and turn the Army Commander into his brother-in-law?

Pfft, shameless!

Han Xiao was not moved. He stood up and said, "Alright, I'll get someone to arrange your position in the future. You two haven't seen each other for many years, so you should have a lot to talk about. I still have things to do, so I'll be leaving first."

As he spoke, he turned around and walked out of the guest room, leaving behind a burly figure.

After watching Han Xiao leave, Reynold turned around and stared at Rossellin. He frowned and said, "I'm warning you, if you still have any bad intentions when you come back this time, I'll be the first to catch you!"

"You don't trust me that much?" Rossellin raised her eyebrows slightly.

"Humph, I know too well what kind of person you are!" Reynold crossed his arms and said expressionlessly, "Also, I advise you to be more respectful to the Army Commander. Subordinates should behave like subordinates!"

"Yo, we haven't seen each other in a few decades, and you're already so loyal to Black Star?" Rossellin was amazed. Suddenly, she thought of something, lowered her voice, and chuckled. "How about it? Do you want a brother-in-law?"

"What do you want?" Reynold's eyebrows furrowed even tighter.

"I think a man like Black Star who can topple the universe is very compatible with me. What do you think?" Rossellin said in a teasing tone.

Reynold snorted in disdain.

"Those who covet Black Star's body can circle the base six times. You? Go line up! "
